# Timly

> > Timly is a cloud-based inventory management and asset tracking software featuring QR-Code, RFID, and GPS technologies for digitizing asset management across industries.

Timly provides comprehensive inventory management solutions for diverse sectors including retail, construction, healthcare, education, and hospitality. The platform combines mobile apps, maintenance management, warehouse tracking, and AI-powered features to replace manual processes and reduce asset losses by up to 75%.

## Key Topics

- Inventory Management
- Asset Tracking
- QR-Code & RFID
- GPS Tracking
- Mobile App
- Equipment Management
- Warehouse Management
- Maintenance Management (CMMS)
- Barcode Scanning
- Cloud Software
- Multi-Location Support
- Digital Procurement
- Timly AI
- Fleet Management
- Single Sign-On Integration
